# Less Annoying CRM | Product Overview

Less Annoying CRM is the very simple contact person and conduit CRM that provides a single price for small businesses without a set wall. The product core builds a unified workspace around customer relations, sales implementation and revenue processes, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
